results.title: Chucky & Tiffany Do London: International Murder & Mayhem
results.original_title: Chucky & Tiffany Do London: International Murder & Mayhem
results.overview: The world's most deadly dolls come to London to wed and honey moon. However, life imitates art as people they have met go missing under suspicious circumstances. Hot on their synthetic heels is media super star and American investigator - Wayne Ringburn. As the mutilated bodies of the missing begin to pile up, Ringburn himself seems in danger of joining them as he vow's to track Chucky and Tiffany down.

results.title: Minister Chucky
results.overview: As the specter of rising fascism looms, a queer couple celebrates their love with an unconventional Vegas wedding—officiated by Chucky, the killer doll—before making their escape to Canada.

results.title: Chucky Lou - Story of a Woodchuck
results.original_title: Chucky Lou - Story of a Woodchuck
results.overview: Tells the story of a woodchuck which was taken to a state park to live and now entertains the park visitors by performing tricks. Shows the woodchuck's appearance, size, natural habitat, food, habits, and adjustment to captivity.

known_for.name: Life with Elizabeth
known_for.overview: Elizabeth and Alvin are a married couple who live an ordinary suburban life, but inevitably managed to get into predicaments. At the end of most predicaments, Alvin, in variable degrees of frustration, would say, "I shall leave you now, Elizabeth" and would walk out of sight. The announcer would say, "Elizabeth, aren't you ashamed?" She would slowly nod, but then, with a slightly devilish grin, would vigorously shake her head to indicate she wasn't.

results.title: Spotlight on Location: The Making of Bride of Chucky

results.overview: Short documentary about the production of BRIDE OF CHUCKY.

results.title: Chucky Boy Blue
results.overview: On the cusp of adulthood, Vinny and his father must renegotiate their relationship, and confront the father's childhood trauma.

known_for.title: El coso
known_for.overview: Federico Manuel Peralta Ramos was an artist responsible for the creation of a work that it was as ephemeral as it is eternal. He was born in a traditional family, but some years later the curiosity for the art scene, night life and avant-garde development pushed him to live within the iconoclastic and unbiased young 60's crowd.

known_for.name: NYPD Blue
known_for.overview: Police drama set in New York City, exploring the internal and external struggles of the fictional 15th precinct of Manhattan. Each episode typically intertwined several plots involving an ensemble cast.

known_for.title: Come the Morning
known_for.overview: In search of her estranged husband, a mother brings her 3 children to Los Angeles in the hope of finding him. With no prospects they wander the streets; becoming beggars before long. Things start to turn around for them when the mother meets a Christian missionary.

It is a religious battle for their leader, clad in priest's robes, who they believe has supernatural powers to extinguish life out of anyone. Outnumbered, Lt. Cary Altamonte's group fights for the safety of the civilians. The situation unfolds in a battle of faith.

known_for.title: Preternatural

Unknown to them a killer who resembles death is cleansing the countryside. With a wannabe policeman and an assortment of the public out for some fresh air, the woods are no place to go down today.

known_for.overview: Take a ride to hell and back with killers of all sadistic stripes, including monsters, clowns, cannibalistic tribes, crazy locksmiths, and more.

results.title: Child's Play
results.overview: An innocent-looking doll is inhabited by the soul of a serial killer who refuses to die.

results.title: Child's Play 2
results.overview: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.

results.title: Child's Play 3
results.overview: Eight years after seemingly destroying the killer doll, teen Andy Barclay is placed in a military school, and the spirit of Chucky returns to renew his quest and seek vengeance after being recreated from a mass of melted plastic.

results.title: Dangerous Worry Dolls
results.overview: While serving time in a brutal women's detention center. Eva wishes away her troubles to a set of tiny Worry Dolls. The dolls crawl in her ear at night and soon Eva becomes possessed.

known_for.title: The Dark Knight
known_for.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

known_for.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
known_for.overview: Bourne is brought out of hiding once again by reporter Simon Ross who is trying to unveil Operation Blackbriar, an upgrade to Project Treadstone, in a series of newspaper columns. Information from the reporter stirs a new set of memories, and Bourne must finally uncover his dark past while dodging The Company's best efforts to eradicate him.

known_for.title: Wrong Turn 3: Left for Dead
known_for.overview: A group of people find themselves trapped in the backwoods of West Virginia, fighting for their lives against a group of vicious and horribly disfigured inbred cannibals.

known_for.title: Luchadoras
known_for.overview: The courageous female wrestlers of Ciudad Juárez, a city known for its high murder rate against women - who fight in the ring and in their daily lives to redefine the image of what it means to be a woman in Mexico.
